products.name: Vintage Blossom Crochet Keychain
products.description: Delicately crocheted five-petal blossom keychain handcrafted from 100% mercerized Egyptian cotton thread. Finished with a brushed rose-gold keyring and a tiny hand-stamped brass petal charm.
products.materials: 100% Mercerized Cotton, Brass Hardware, Rose Gold Finish

products.name: Handmade Crochet Tulip Stem
products.description: An everlasting spring tulip sculpted from buttery soft milk cotton yarn. Features a flexible wrapped floral wire stem and a lifelike leaf that can be gently shaped in any vase.
products.materials: Premium Milk Cotton Yarn, Wrapped Floral Wire Core

products.name: Wildflower Embroidered Hair Clips (Set of 3)
products.description: Trio of vintage alligator clips upholstered in unbleached Belgian linen and meticulously embroidered with tiny forget-me-nots and French knot rosebuds. Gentle grip suitable for all hair types.
products.materials: Belgian Linen, Silk Embroidery Floss, Non-slip Alligator Base

products.name: Meadow Whisper Crochet Bouquet
products.description: A breathtaking permanent arrangement featuring 7 hand-crocheted blooms: two blush garden roses, one ivory tulip, chamomile daisies, and delicate eucalyptus sprigs wrapped in craft parchment.
products.materials: Combed Cotton Yarns, Paper-wrapped Wire, Silk Ribbon Tie

products.name: Botanical Silk Scrunchie & Detachable Ribbon
products.description: Hand-dyed mulberry silk scrunchie paired with an optional detachable embroidered ribbon tail. Dyed using natural rosehip and madder root extracts for a soft romantic patina.
products.materials: 100% Organic Mulberry Silk, Natural Botanical Plant Dyes

products.name: Mini Daisy Crochet Bag Charm
products.description: A whimsical sunny daisy charm with sunny yellow core and pure white petals. Designed to clip effortlessly onto totes, straw summer bags, or key pouches.
products.materials: Perle Cotton Yarn, Lobster Swivel Clasp

products.name: Scalloped Linen Peter Pan Collar
products.description: A detachable statement collar crafted from washed oatmeal European linen, bordered with delicate hand-crocheted picot lace and tied with satin ribbons.
products.materials: 100% European Flax Linen, Hand-crocheted Lace Trim

products.name: Bespoke Heirloom Baby Bonnet & Booties
products.description: Softest organic bamboo-cotton baby keepsake set customized with the child's embroidered initials and birth date along the bonnet brim.
products.materials: Organic Bamboo-Cotton Blend, Silk Satin Ribbon

fashionPortfolio.title: The Scalloped Linen Smock Dress
fashionPortfolio.description: Hand-tailored smock dress made from high-thread unbleached European flax linen. Features hand-crocheted picot trim on the Peter Pan collar and billowy gathered cuffs.
fashionPortfolio.fabrics: 100% GOTS Organic European Flax Linen, Hand-dyed Cotton Thread
fashionPortfolio.sizes: Made to Measure (XS to 3XL custom drafting)

fashionPortfolio.title: Botanical Sleeve Silk Atelier Blouse
fashionPortfolio.description: Romantic blouson sleeve blouse crafted from sandwashed silk habotai, embellished with miniature embroidered daisy sprigs and hand-crocheted covered buttons.
fashionPortfolio.fabrics: Sandwashed Mulberry Silk Habotai, Fine French Lace
